renderContract.identity: Radiance is the same clearly adult fictional heroine, age 21: long golden-blonde hair, luminous blue eyes, fresh youthful facial proportions and skin, athletic confidence, poised warmth, intelligence, beauty, and a capable presence. Preserve her recognizable identity and Starlight-era energy without copying an earlier composition; never age her up with harsh lines, weathered texture, or overly mature styling.
renderContract.image: Create one new vertical HQ hyper-photorealistic fashion-action photograph per scene with 4K-cinematic visual polish. Show her complete decisive movement, readable hands and face, convincing anatomy, refined youthful skin detail, luxurious materials, cinematic practical light, full color, and a location with real spatial depth.
renderContract.artDirection: Fashion is the first read, purposeful movement is the second, and the impossible or extraordinary world is the third. Every frame needs a visual thesis, a distinct silhouette, a new camera language, and an observable heroic objective. Prefer low, aerial, chase, underwater, macro-wide, Dutch, reflection, or long-lens compositions over eye-level poster poses.
renderContract.wardrobe: Prioritize bold Scorpion Generation sport-swim couture, exposed shoulders, midriff and athletic legs, sculptural two-piece construction, daring color blocking, and creative high-gloss, technical-knit, neoprene, pearlescent, or liquid-metal materials. Rotate other couture only when the scene mechanics require it. Use saturated gold, cobalt, scarlet, ultraviolet, turquoise, tangerine, electric fuchsia, and scene-specific color. Clothing is fully opaque, secure for the action, non-explicit, and public-archive safe.
renderContract.continuity: A thorned-rose clasp, scorpion emblem, gold utility jewelry, or scarlet ribbon may appear as an occasional signature, never as a compulsory repeated prop.
renderContract.avoid: No static command-console scenes, repetitive pointing, generic standing portraits, copied poses, real agency or extremist branding, graphic violence, executions, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothes, explicit posing, readable text, logos, watermarks, broken anatomy, or duplicated limbs.

scenes.title: Night Garden Light Dance
scenes.brief: She moves through a night garden placing low-impact pollinator lights, direct flash and gold trails balancing science with glamour.

scenes.title: Monsoon Rain-Garden Sprint
scenes.brief: Radiance sprints across a rain-garden bridge to open a flood gate, water and scarlet tailoring flying outward.

scenes.title: Drought Cloud-Sensor Glide
scenes.brief: She pilots a silent glider to place a weather sensor near developing clouds, no claims of weather control, gold desert below.

scenes.title: Hail-Net Trapeze Repair
scenes.brief: Radiance uses a secured farm trapeze to mend a protective orchard net as small hail sparkles around her.

scenes.title: River-Gauge Kayak Turn
scenes.brief: A hard kayak turn places her beside a rising-river gauge with a new transmitter, green water and cobalt-gold waterproof fashion.

scenes.title: Air: Skybridge Wing Run
scenes.brief: Radiance races a transparent skybridge carrying an emergency wing, clouds and gold fabric forming a heroic spiral.

scenes.title: Water: Cenote Rope Dive
scenes.brief: She dives on a secured line through a sunlit fictional cenote to retrieve a sensor, full marine couture and turquoise depth.

scenes.title: Earth: Crystal Cavern Climb
scenes.brief: Radiance climbs between immense mineral columns to place a stability beacon, low gold light and matte-black expedition fashion.

scenes.title: Fire: Solar Furnace Shield
scenes.brief: She swings a reflective shield into alignment at a solar furnace test field, controlled light rather than flames, scarlet-white tailoring.

scenes.title: Polar-to-Desert Relay
scenes.brief: A split-climate research bridge frames Radiance sprinting a data baton from ice light into desert gold, one continuous surreal world.

scenes.title: Ocean-to-Orbit Climb
scenes.brief: She climbs a fictional tether rising from sea spray into space, carrying a seed-vault capsule through changing atmosphere.

scenes.title: Forest-to-City Glide
scenes.brief: Radiance glides from rainforest canopy into a green metropolis to deliver biodiversity data, landscape transition filling the frame.

scenes.title: Night-to-Dawn Skate
scenes.brief: She speed-skates a mirrored causeway from a neon night skyline toward sunrise, replacing guide lights as she moves.

scenes.title: Orbital Gala Chandelier Swing
scenes.brief: In couture rescue eveningwear, Radiance swings from a zero-gravity chandelier to catch a drifting power crystal before a gala resumes.

scenes.title: Underwater Ballroom Current Turn
scenes.brief: She turns through a transparent underwater ballroom to close a loose observation panel, full-coverage gold-blue formal marine couture.

scenes.title: Desert Opera Wind Run
scenes.brief: Radiance runs across a wind-shaped opera stage to secure a sail canopy, scarlet evening coat carving the storm.

scenes.title: Ice Pavilion Skate Repair
scenes.brief: She figure-skates through a crystalline research pavilion and catches a falling light module, white-gold tailoring and cobalt ice.

scenes.title: World Engine Gold Leap
scenes.brief: Radiance leaps between rotating rings of a benevolent climate research engine to insert its final gold core, Earth beyond.

scenes.title: Nebula Runway Rescue Return
scenes.brief: She returns to the nebula on a fashion runway that becomes a rescue bridge, sprinting with a secured archive case through violet light.

scenes.title: Global Aurora Relay Finish
scenes.brief: Radiance breaks a luminous relay plane above the atmosphere as worldwide research lights come alive below, full-body victory in motion.

scenes.title: Radiance: Starlight Hero
scenes.brief: The only deliberate near-portrait: Radiance steps forward from a storm of worlds carrying no weapon, coat moving, face warm and experienced, every prior palette reflected around her.
